title: 1701 Prairie's carved window hoods and corner pilaster
items: Every arched window on the front and south side of the Hibbard house at 1701 Prairie now sits under a light stone hood whose ends step out at the arch's foot and whose crown rises to a point, as its old photograph shows; side-by-side windows meet hood to hood.
A tall stone pilaster now stands on the house's front corner, from the stone basement up to a capital under the cornice.
